<style>
  .kl-card {
    min-height: 450px;
  }
  
</style>

<!-- BrandCommand: footer redesign -->
<style>
/* ── Footer Complete Redesign ── */
footer, .footer, .hs-footer, [data-hs-cos-type="footer"],
body > div:last-child > footer,
.body-container > footer {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #060e1a 0%, #0b1829 100%) !important;
  padding: 40px 5% 0 !important;
  margin-top: 0 !important;
  font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif !important;
}

/* Hide excessive footer widgets/sections - keep only essentials */
footer .hs-menu-wrapper,
.footer .hs-menu-wrapper,
footer .widget-type-menu,
.footer .widget-type-menu {
  display: block !important;
}

/* Footer inner container - CSS Grid 3 columns */
footer .content-wrapper,
footer .page-center,
footer > div:first-child,
.footer .content-wrapper,
.footer .page-center,
.footer > div:first-child,
footer .row-fluid,
.footer .row-fluid {
  display: grid !important;
  grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr !important;
  gap: 30px !important;
  max-width: 1200px !important;
  margin: 0 auto !important;
  padding: 0 20px !important;
  align-items: start !important;
}

/* All footer text styling */
footer, footer *,
.footer, .footer * {
  color: #8a8f9b !important;
  font-size: 14px !important;
  line-height: 1.6 !important;
  border: none !important;
}

/* Footer headings */
footer h1, footer h2, footer h3, footer h4, footer h5, footer h6,
.footer h1, .footer h2, .footer h3, .footer h4, .footer h5, .footer h6 {
  color: #ffffff !important;
  font-size: 15px !important;
  font-weight: 600 !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px !important;
  text-transform: uppercase !important;
  margin-bottom: 12px !important;
}

/* Footer links */
footer a, .footer a {
  color: #8a8f9b !important;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  transition: color 0.2s ease !important;
  display: block !important;
  padding: 2px 0 !important;
}
footer a:hover, .footer a:hover {
  color: #c4a44a !important;
}

/* Footer list items - compact */
footer ul, .footer ul {
  list-style: none !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
}
footer li, .footer li {
  padding: 2px 0 !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
}

/* Footer images (logos) - constrain */
footer img, .footer img {
  max-height: 40px !important;
  width: auto !important;
  margin-bottom: 12px !important;
  filter: brightness(0) invert(1) !important;
  opacity: 0.9 !important;
}

/* Social icons */
footer .social-links a,
footer .hs-social-media a,
.footer .social-links a,
.footer .hs-social-media a {
  display: inline-block !important;
  margin-right: 12px !important;
  opacity: 0.7 !important;
}
footer .social-links a:hover,
footer .hs-social-media a:hover,
.footer .social-links a:hover,
.footer .hs-social-media a:hover {
  opacity: 1 !important;
  color: #c4a44a !important;
}

/* Copyright bar */
footer .footer-bottom,
footer .copyright,
footer > div:last-child,
.footer .footer-bottom,
.footer .copyright {
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(138, 143, 155, 0.15) !important;
  margin-top: 30px !important;
  padding: 15px 0 !important;
  text-align: center !important;
  font-size: 12px !important;
  grid-column: 1 / -1 !important;
}

/* Remove any background images in footer */
footer [style*="background-image"],
.footer [style*="background-image"] {
  background-image: none !important;
}

/* Reduce overall footer height */
footer .span12, .footer .span12,
footer .cell, .footer .cell {
  padding: 0 !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
}

/* Hide duplicate/empty sections */
footer .dnd-section:empty,
.footer .dnd-section:empty {
  display: none !important;
}

/* DnD rows in footer - flatten */
footer .dnd-section,
.footer .dnd-section {
  padding: 0 !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  max-width: 100% !important;
}
footer .dnd-column,
.footer .dnd-column {
  padding: 0 10px !important;
}
</style>

params.prose:
4 Easy Steps to get you Onboarded Successfully

Kickoff & Discovery

Within 7 business days, you’ll meet your dedicated HubSpot Strategist. This initial session is all about understanding your business, goals, and setting the foundation for a successful onboarding experience.

Strategy & Mapping

In the following week, you’ll work closely with your Strategist to align on a tailored onboarding plan—mapped directly to your objectives and designed for a seamless rollout.

Guided Implementation

Over the next 4–6 weeks, our team will guide you through every key step. You’ll gain hands-on experience and confidence using HubSpot, supported by experts who keep your progress on track.

Confident Execution

By the end of onboarding, your team will be fully equipped to manage HubSpot independently. With systems in place and knowledge in hand, you’re ready to make HubSpot a core part of your operations.
